sources.name: Ørje sluser
sources.finding: Official municipal interpretation identifies the 1860 hand-operated lock complex west of Ørje centre and documents its approximately ten-metre lift.

sources.name: Haldenkanalen
sources.finding: The municipality documents canal construction from 1852 to 1860 and distinguishes Ørje locks, Strømsfoss locks and the wider waterway.

sources.name: Haldenkanalen
sources.finding: NVE documents the opening of Ørje locks in 1860, the canal's timber-transport role and continued floating until 1982.

sources.name: Ørje sluser
sources.finding: Destination information identifies three lock chambers and an operating passage time of about 30 minutes.

sources.name: Haldenvassdragets Kanalmuseum
sources.finding: The museum occupies the former Ørje Brug pulp mill beside the locks and interprets canal, timber-floating and steamboat history.

rejectedCandidates.reason: Adjacent interpretation institution and industrial building, not the lock complex itself.

representationLimits: The marker represents the three-chamber Ørje lock complex.
